R1: board empty. Slow query WARNs (200-450ms) everywhere = noise. inventory-svc DNS SERVFAIL host=rates.internal at round-01/logs/inventory-svc.log:7,20,50. round-01/changes.md:3 CHG-107 APPLIED retry budget GETs=1.
R2: round-02/board.md:3 Thread A DNS_RESOLUTION inventory-svc+checkout-api ongoing. round-02/changes.md:3 CHG-120 APPLIED build 8.59.8 search-api sets http.max_inflight=-1 (possible BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT, watch search-api); changes.md:4 CHG-121 auth-svc no config. DNS errors round-02/logs/checkout-api.log:8,24,59; round-02/logs/inventory-svc.log:8,12,74.
R3: round-03/board.md:3 Thread B auth-svc suspected DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED ongoing, BUT logs show only tls certificate_expired peer=sso.example.net at round-03/logs/auth-svc.log:6,9,15,21,25 (likely real cause CERT_EXPIRED). DNS continues round-03/logs/checkout-api.log:33,37,44; inventory-svc.log:3,7,15. changes.md:3 CHG-126 PROPOSED (ignore). search-api no errors yet.
Grep pattern used: ERROR|FATAL|CRIT|SERVFAIL|429|refused|exhaust|OOM|expired|lag|disk|invalid, excluding slow query.
R4: board empty. CERT errors round-04/logs/auth-svc.log:6,8,16 and shipping-svc.log:3,20,27 (shipping-svc also cert expired sso). DNS continues checkout-api.log:1,8,11; inventory-svc.log:32,36,38. search-api clean.
R5: round-05/board.md:3 Thread A mitigated after round-05/changes.md:3 CHG-143 APPLIED. board.md:4 Thread B adds shipping-svc, cause still DB_POOL (board) but logs CERT_EXPIRED round-05/logs/auth-svc.log:2,8,14; shipping-svc.log:9,11,34. board.md:5 OPEN VENDOR_TICKET; board.md:6 OPEN ALERT_TUNING. No DNS errors in R5.
R6: round-06/board.md:3 OPEN RUNBOOK_UPDATE. changes.md:3 CHG-144 noise. CERT continues round-06/logs/auth-svc.log:4,10,14; shipping-svc.log:1,18,21. No DNS, search-api clean.
R7: round-07/board.md:3 Thread B cause revised CERT_EXPIRED (auth-svc+shipping-svc). board.md:4 Thread D UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT search-api ongoing; logs 429 upstream=tax-provider round-07/logs/search-api.log:4,5,20,22. CERT continues round-07/logs/auth-svc.log:1,16,24; shipping-svc.log:10,11,23. No changes.md R7. Next: advance to R8.
R8: round-08/board.md:3 Thread A resolved; board.md:4 Thread B mitigated; board.md:5 Thread C search-api failures cause unknown ongoing; board.md:6 OPEN DATA_BACKFILL; board.md:7 CLOSED VENDOR_TICKET. search-api logs: 429 tax-provider round-08/logs/search-api.log:1 AND config validation failed http.max_inflight=-1 build 8.59.8 at search-api.log:2,5 (BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT from CHG-120, Thread C). CERT still in logs auth-svc.log:8,61; shipping-svc.log:50,60. No DNS. No changes.md R8. Next: advance to R9.
R9: round-09/board.md:3 Thread C note pods still restarting, ongoing. changes.md:3 CHG-166 noise. search-api 429 tax-provider round-09/logs/search-api.log:1,5,11,20; config validation failed http.max_inflight round-09/logs/search-api.log:2,9,13,19. CERT still auth-svc.log:22,55; shipping-svc.log:28,56. No DNS. Next: advance to R10.
